answer:
The job tried to load knowledge_bu/retrieval_lab from rhpds/agnosticv@main (the Babylon name is knowledge_bu.retrieval_lab.prod). The stat of that directory came back exists: false and the assert stopped the run.

The item is not gone. A catalog lookup finds it (found: true) in rhpds/agnosticv at knowledge_bu/retrieval-lab, with common.yaml, dev.yaml and prod.yaml. It was not deleted in the cleanup.

Why the job could not find it: the names differ by one character. The job asked for retrieval_lab with an underscore; the directory is retrieval-lab with a hyphen. The catalog lookup treats _ and - as the same, which is why it reports a match, but the job checks the literal path, and knowledge_bu/retrieval_lab does not exist. This is not a GitHub glitch, so relaunching would fail the same way; I have not relaunched it. Point the order's catalog item at knowledge_bu.retrieval-lab.prod (the hyphenated name) and order again.
